title: Lunar Combustion Investigation: Flammability Results from a Rotating Sounding Rocket (Ferkul, Johnston, Kralik, Liao; ASGSR 2025 Annual Meeting presentation, 44 slides)
sources_read: nasa/ntrs-20250010653/ASGSR 2025-LUCI-Ferkul-Presentation-v2-20250010653.pdf (via page-marked text dump, all 44 pages; page rendering failed (pdftoppm not installed), so image-only pages 9, 11, 14, 15, 32, 35 and the plots on pages 19-44 were NOT seen)
method_notes: source_location page=<n> is the 1-based PDF page = slide number.

Multi-line text is joined with one space. Bullet characters are not included in quotes. Quotes from the two comparison tables (page 33, page 36) are the table's text layer in reading order joined with single spaces; the header-to-value mapping was checked arithmetically (page 33: .9/1.5 = .6, 1.1/2.8 = .39; page 36: .15/.40 = .38), not visually.
Records carry an extra 'note' field where the quote alone does not say which quantity (e.g. flame base vs flame tip) or where an attribution needs the slide title.
No value was read from a plot. No unit was converted. Nothing was computed (the deck's 11 RPM and 1.22 m radius were NOT turned into a g value).

tests.description: SIBAL fabric (cotton-fiberglass), burned in simulated Lunar gravity on the rotating Blue Origin New Shepard flight; the deck's slides for it are titled 'LUCI: SIBAL fabric' and 'LUCI Partial-G Recap: SIBAL'.
4-mm-diameter acrylic (PMMA) rod, burned simultaneously with the fabric in simulated Lunar gravity on the same flight; slides titled 'LUCI: PMMA'.
Ground burn of SIBAL fabric at Earth gravity ('LUCI 1-G Updates'); slides titled '1-G Results: SIBAL fabric' / '1-G Results: SIBAL'.
Ground burn of PMMA at Earth gravity; slides titled '1-G Results: PMMA' (slide 31 text layer reads only 'Results: PMMA').

not_found.reason: No numeric g value (0.16, 1/6, 0.17 g ...) is written anywhere in the text layer. Page 12 gives 'A steady vehicle rotation of 11 RPM is established, with an effective radius of rotation of 1.22 m at the experiment location.' A g value could be computed from this, but the deck does not state it, so it is not recorded. g-vs-time appears only as plots (pages 26, 30, 41, 44 bullets refer to them). Partial-g PMMA g history is inconsistent in text: pages 22/43 say gravity decreased at 125 s; page 44 says 'Gravity remains ~constant for duration of the burn.' (DISCREPANCY on g history, not on regime).
No thickness stated. Fabric is given as 5 cm wide x 30 cm long; PMMA as a 4-mm diameter rod (diameter is not a thickness).
1-g sample dimensions/form are not stated; the 1-g slides only name 'SIBAL fabric' and 'PMMA'. Not filled by analogy with the flight samples.

No 'opposed', 'concurrent' or 'quiescent' stated. The deck states spread directions only ('burning downward' SIBAL, 'burning upward' PMMA, page 16; 'Oxygen limits for upward and downward spread', page 3). Mapping a direction to a flow configuration would be inference.
No forced-flow or buoyant-flow velocity stated.
The 1-g slides do not say 'air' or name a diluent; only O2% values (~20-21%) are given. Not inferred.
Not stated for the ground tests. For the flight tests only the qualitative 'normal pressure' (page 12) exists (R25, R26); no number in any unit.
Temperature is listed as a sensor ('Sensors: Chamber oxygen concentration, pressure, temperature, and centrifugal acceleration.') but no value is given.
Ground test facility/hardware not named ('Data from 1-g burns' only).
No sentence states extinction for the 1-g PMMA burn. Page 23 says generally for 1-g 'the flame burns out much quicker' without naming the sample: not attributed.

'O2% rises back to 15.8% likely due to the decrease in gravity (and thus buoyant flow) which occurred at 125s.' is a later reading, not stated as a final/after-test value. Ranges R27, R28, R30 are recorded as test-level o2 ranges, not as final values.

not_found.test_id: LUCI partial-g SIBAL; LUCI partial-g PMMA; LUCI 1-g SIBAL
not_found.reason: Only lower bounds or partial times in words: page 12 'the burn lasts for over two and a half minutes' (not attributed to one sample, a lower bound in words); page 16 'The flame spread for over a minute.' (SIBAL, lower bound); page 17 'PMMA rod after 90 seconds of burning' (an image time); page 34 '~ 45 seconds sooner' (a difference); page 24 1-g SIBAL flame width 'decreases suddenly at ~24 seconds, and goes to 0 within 4 seconds' (not stated as burn time). None is a stated burn duration.

not_found.test_id: LUCI partial-g PMMA; LUCI 1-g SIBAL; LUCI 1-g PMMA
not_found.reason: Only trends stated ('Flame length increases ~linearly', 'flame shrinks more than partial-g burn'); values only in plots. Page 40 '~ 1.25 cm' is the total DECREASE of flame length for partial-g SIBAL, not a length.
'Flame tip spread rate is ~double flame base spread rate.' is a ratio, not a value.

Pages 40 and 43 mention fit equations (preheat length as difference of fit equations; quadratic fit of PMMA base spread) but no equation text is in the text layer; all curves and axes are figures and were not read. Page 23: 'Fits of the data were created where possible and useful'.

not_found.reason: Flame width ~3.2 cm (page 39); 'Preheat length shrink rate = -0.094 mm/s.' and preheat length decrease ~0.4 cm (page 40): no schema variable for flame width or preheat length.
Ratios .6, .39 (SIBAL) and .38 (PMMA) are comparisons, not conditions or outcomes of one test.
Text layer empty or axis labels only ('+x +y +z' on page 11); page rendering failed (pdftoppm not installed), so their content was not seen.

lineage: The deck does not state any shared samples, hardware or materials with BASS, BASS-II or Saffire (the words do not appear). It states hardware credits 'Glenn Research Center' and 'ZIN Technologies' (pages 6-8; page 13: 'ZIN technologies brought on board October 2021') and names the follow-on 'Flammability of Materials on the Moon (FM2) experiment' (pages 12, 37). Results are 'compared to related 1-g work, drop tower tests, aircraft experiments, and modeling' (page 12) without naming those investigations. No SHARED_LINEAGE flag raised.
